facts.text: Recommended Apps extension is per-tenant extension that curates list of apps for specific customers or business types.
Only apps available on Marketplace can be added to the recommended collection.
Update app.json file with dependency on Recommended Apps per-tenant extension.
Use Recommended Apps codeunit methods to insert, get, update, delete apps and refresh app logos.
Deploy collection to customer tenants to display Recommended Apps page with install links.
